notable_absence.finding: No privilege or Server RBAC role is documented for the /api/managerOptions endpoint shown in the curl examples, despite it being a mutating admin operation (setting maxConcurrentPartitionMovesPerNode) shown with basic-auth credentials in the URL - the same recurring fts/ privilege-documentation gap this batch's version-twin pages also flagged, now appearing on a first-contact page too.

cross_component_finding: This page is the operational detail behind two summary statements on fts-high-availability-for-search.md (same batch): (1) its 'administrator has to explicitly failover the nodes' caveat is spelled out here as the full five-step Failover-recovery procedure (fts:manual-failover-for-search), and (2) its bare mention of 'Number of replicas' as an availability factor is explained here mechanically - 'the search service does not wait for all replicas of an index to be built... since the replica partitions are not used for serving FTS query traffic' during rebalance, and 'Failover triggers replica partitions to become active' during an actual failure. The two pages were dispatched together in this batch specifically to be read against each other, and they do connect.
